text: Hello, children.It's me, Ms.Wong.Nice to see you again.今天起,我们要开启新一章的学习。We are going to learn module 4, unit 1, on the farm.在上课时,希望大家能做到。Listen carefully, look carefully, and speak loudly.Are you ready?Let's begin.Look, Ms.Wong and the children are on the bus.Where are they going?今天,Ms.Wong和同学们会去哪儿呢?Let's go and have a look.Children, here we are.Ah, they are on the farm.原来他们来到了农场上。Then, what can they see on the farm?Listen.I can see flowers on the farm.I can see trees on the farm.Look, a house on the farm.How nice!Then, what else is on the farm?Let's watch.It's a chick.Peep, peep.Quack, quack.What's that?It's a duck.Ah, they can see animals on the farm.原来在农场上,他们还发现了一些农场动物呢。Look, here are Eddie and Alice.他们发现了什么?Moo, moo.It's a cow.They can see a cow.Listen to Alice.Can you try?Look, this is a cow.It's big.It goes moo, moo.Follow me.Cow, cow.Watch my mouth.Ow, cow.Oh, here comes a small cow.Alice sees the cows.Look, a big cow.A small cow.Alice has a rhyme about the cows.Listen to her.Big cow, small cow, one and two.Big cow, small cow, I see you.Children, would you like to try?Here you go.Good try.Alice says,It's a cow.Now look and listen.Try again.Oink, oink.Oh, what's the sound?什么声音啊?Let's go and find out.What's this?It's a pig.They can see a pig.Look, here comes the pig.It's fat.Pig, pig.Alice sees the pig.Look at the pig.Super Alice.She has a new rhyme about the pig.A pig, a pig.Fat and big.I like this rhyme.Enju, would you like to try?Here we go.Good job.Alice knows.Eddie and Alice can see a cow and a pig on the farm.What do they say?Now let's listen and follow.Please.You try.You please?Good.Eddie and Alice are happy.They can see the farm animals.What about Kitty and Danny?Let's follow them and have a look.Look.这是什么?Kitty想知道。This.Again.这到底是什么呢?Danny knows.Look at the animal.It's small and it's lovely.Chick, chick.Kitty wants to know.那是什么?这一次她又是怎么问的呢?Have a try.That.Can you?Then what's that?Now Danny knows.But it's lovely.It calls.Duck, duck.Can you be Danny?Listen to him.Kitty and Danny are so happy.They can see a lovely chick and a duck.They want to sing.Oh, what's this?Oh, what's that?Oh, I love this song.And you?Let's sing together.How lovely.Kitty and Danny can see the farm animals.當Kitty想知道進出的是什麼,她問,What's this?當Kitty想知道遠處的是什麼,她又問,What's that?Children, let's do role play.讓我們玩一玩角色扮演吧。First, you are Danny.試著回答Kitty的提問吧。Your turn.Your place.This time, you are Kitty.試著向Danny提問吧。You go first.Well done.今天我們四位小夥伴在農場上發現了一些農場動物。讓我們再跟著他們一起看一看說一說吧。Your try.Go on.Well done, children.Happy time flies.快樂的時光過得可真快。Miss Fang和同學們要準備離開農場了。在走之前,他們想和農場動物們道別呢。Children, it's time to say goodbye.Say goodbye to the cow.Say goodbye to the pig.Say goodbye to the duck.Say goodbye to the chick.小朋友們,讓我們跟著一起跟農場動物們說再見吧。Goodbye, cow.Goodbye, pig.Goodbye, duck.Goodbye, chick.Wow, you are very nice.Oh, here comes the bus.Miss Fang and the children are going back to school.下一節課裡,Miss Fang和同學們要玩一個跟農場動物有關的遊戲。讓我們一起期待吧。So much for today, children.You did a good job.Thank you.Hope to see you next time.Bye bye.
